VERDICT: 77/100 - Core rail, mobile overflow, responsive art, and interaction fixes hold; /blog is a misleading 404, hero still exposes a placeholder, and footer density claim is only partial.

## Scope and evidence

Real headed Chromium via `agent-browser`. OURS: `http://localhost:3001/`. Reference: `https://dai.is-a.dev/`. Checked 1440x900 and 390x844 in light and dark. Pointer, keyboard, palette, theme, anchors, `/blog`, and a random 404 route exercised. Every audit screenshot is in `/tmp/critique/round3/`.

Reference captures: [ref-desktop-default.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-desktop-default.png), [ref-desktop-light-mode.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-desktop-light-mode.png), [ref-mobile-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-mobile-light.png), [ref-mobile-dark.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-mobile-dark.png), [ref-home-bottom.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-home-bottom.png), [ref-blog.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-blog.png).

## Ten claimed fixes

1. **CONFIRMED — mobile header collapse.** At 390x844, document/body `scrollWidth = 390`; header is `x=0..390`, 56px high; nav links and command trigger are `display:none`; GitHub and theme controls remain fully inside the bar (`theme x=341..373`, 32px). Evidence: [ours-mobile-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-light.png), [ours-mobile-dark.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-dark.png).

2. **CONFIRMED — mobile heatmap fits.** At 390px, listbox is `x=11..379` (368px); cells occupy `x=14..376`; exactly 26 columns, 7 rows; document horizontal overflow is 0px. Evidence: [ours-mobile-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-light.png), [ours-heatmap-focus.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-heatmap-focus.png).

3. **CONFIRMED — hero art language and scale.** Desktop figure plate is `x=502..1103` (601px); SVG art is `x=518..1087`, 569px wide and 360px high (~95% plate width). Hatch, isometric edges, and lattice are visible in both themes; mobile art reaches nearly the full `x=8..382` plate. Evidence: [ours-desktop-light-final.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-desktop-light-final.png), [ours-desktop-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-desktop-light.png), [ours-mobile-dark.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-dark.png).

4. **CONFIRMED on home, route exception noted below — one pre-footer band.** Home bottom has one full-width diagonal band before footer. Evidence: [ours-home-bottom.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-home-bottom.png). The 404 shell still renders two bands; see New must-fix 3.

5. **PARTIAL — denser ruled footer.** Metadata labels/values are aligned into two columns, but footer has no reference-style inner ruled cells and remains a sparse 452px block on mobile. Reference uses a dense multi-cell matrix. Evidence: [ours-home-bottom.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-home-bottom.png), [ours-mobile-bottom.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-bottom.png), compared with [ref-home-bottom.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-home-bottom.png).

6. **CONFIRMED — semantic project icon tiles.** Visible project rows use distinct terminal/layers/phone/server/document/grid/chat/window glyphs, not one repeated cube. Evidence: [ours-project-hover.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-project-hover.png).

7. **CONFIRMED — mobile hero density/slot proportions.** At 390px, art, portrait slot, name row, descriptor, social row, and separator all fit without clipping; portrait slot is 132px wide and 130px high, with name column beside it. Evidence: [ours-mobile-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-light.png), [ours-mobile-dark.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-dark.png).

8. **CONFIRMED — desktop nav casing/weight.** `Activity` and `Work` render title case at the same compact medium-weight scale in both themes; no overflow at 1440px. Evidence: [ours-desktop-light-final.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-desktop-light-final.png), [ref-desktop-light-mode.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-desktop-light-mode.png).

9. **PARTIAL — focus-ring normalization.** Header links/buttons and social links show consistent 2px, 2px-offset keyboard outlines. Heatmap focus exposes a selected-cell outline and tooltip, but the listbox ring itself is effectively invisible; palette navigation uses a filled selection row rather than the same ring treatment. Evidence: [ours-palette-navigate.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-palette-navigate.png), [ours-heatmap-focus.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-heatmap-focus.png).

10. **CONFIRMED — authored micro-detail.** “arrow keys walk the grid” annotation, arrow graphic, `Fig. 1.`, and `Fig. 2. feed stalled — last updated Jul 17` are present and visible; this reads authored rather than stock dashboard copy. Evidence: [ours-project-hover.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-project-hover.png), [ours-heatmap-focus.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-heatmap-focus.png).

## New must-fix items

1. **Implement `/blog`, or remove the route/nav expectation.** `http://localhost:3001/blog` returns HTTP 404 (`performance` navigation status 404), title says `Blog · Dhruv Sharma`, and body is only “Nothing lives here 404”. Reference `/blog` returns 200 with search plus article cards. This is a broken product surface, not a stylistic difference. Evidence: [ours-blog-desktop.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-blog-desktop.png), [ours-blog.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-blog.png), [ref-blog.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-blog.png).

2. **Remove visible placeholder language from hero.** `DS` plus italic `portrait pending` makes the primary identity block visibly unfinished at every viewport/theme. Reference uses a real portrait and authored name treatment. Evidence: [ours-desktop-light-final.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-desktop-light-final.png), [ours-mobile-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-light.png).

3. **Fix the 404 shell’s duplicate bands and empty-height composition.** `/blog` and a random 404 both show two full-width diagonal bands separated by a large blank region (desktop bands around y=203 and y=449; mobile around y=228 and y=392), contradicting the home fix and making the error page look like a broken layout. Evidence: [ours-blog-desktop.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-blog-desktop.png), [ours-404.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-404.png).

## New polish items

1. **Footer needs reference-level information density.** Home footer is centered credit text with outer rails; reference has aligned ruled cells, compact metadata headers, and a denser closing row. Preserve current alignment, add the cell grammar.

2. **Desktop hero composition is too isolated.** OURS keeps the art inside the 768px rail and leaves broad empty outer margins; reference lets the frame/lattice read across the viewport. Consider extending only the decorative layer beyond the rail while retaining content alignment. Evidence: [ours-desktop-light-final.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-desktop-light-final.png) vs [ref-desktop-light-mode.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ref-desktop-light-mode.png).

3. **Focus affordance needs one token.** Keep the good 2px/2px header treatment, but make listbox focus and palette active state visibly related in both light/dark. Current heatmap state is discoverable only through the cell/tooltip, not a clear container ring.

4. **Hover feedback is functional but quiet.** Project row hover changes `hover:bg-accent-muted` and icon color, yet the delta is barely legible at 1440px. Increase contrast slightly without turning rows into rounded cards.

5. **Check long-form rhythm against reference.** Home rail spacing is coherent, but the 404/footer shell leaves excessive unused vertical space; route-level layouts should share the same measured rhythm instead of stretching to fill a viewport.

## What genuinely gets right

- Mobile header now stays inside 390px, preserves GitHub/theme access, and hides the desktop palette trigger.
- Heatmap is genuinely 26 columns and has zero horizontal document overflow.
- Hero artwork now belongs to the hatched/isometric frame language and scales responsively in light and dark.
- Central rail, vertical rules, full-width separators, tags, and project row spines create a coherent visual system.
- Project icon tiles are semantic and varied.
- Command palette opens, filters/loads a selected row, and keyboard ArrowDown moves selection; captures: [ours-palette-open.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-palette-open.png), [ours-palette-navigate.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-palette-navigate.png), [ours-palette-light.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-palette-light.png).
- Theme toggle works light→dark and dark→light at both tested viewports; captures: [ours-desktop-light-final.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-desktop-light-final.png), [ours-mobile-dark.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-mobile-dark.png).
- Sticky header and section anchors behave: `#activity` and `#work` land at y≈88px, below the 56px header; captures: [ours-anchor-activity.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-anchor-activity.png), [ours-anchor-work.png](/tmp/critique/round3/ours-anchor-work.png).
- Pointer hover and keyboard focus are present on project rows, header controls, social links, palette, and heatmap; they need consistency polish, not a ground-up interaction rewrite.

fix: close the round-three gaps found against the reference

The round-three audit drove both sites in a real browser and scored 77/100,
confirming eight of the ten round-two claims and finding three new defects.
This closes all of them.

Duplicate stripe bands on every non-home route. The round-two fix that
removed the trailing band was applied to the home page only, so /blog, a
blog post, and the 404 shell each still emitted one directly above the
footer's own — a double border on every route but one. All three now end on
the panel's own hairline, matching the home page.

The 404 left the frame hanging in a void. Its rail stopped under a short
panel and resumed at the footer with unused viewport between. `main` is now
a flex column so a short route can grow a railed spacer down to the footer;
the 404 fills the viewport exactly rather than stretching around a gap.

/blog advertised itself as "Blog" while returning 404. With nothing
published the route calls `notFound()`, but its static metadata still
titled the tab, naming a page the Visitor cannot reach. Metadata is now
derived from whether any Post exists, and both 404 surfaces read the same.

The hero no longer ships a visible placeholder. "portrait pending" made the
primary identity block read as unfinished at every size; the monogram plate
now stands as a deliberate mark and the rationale moved onto `Avatar`.

The footer is a ruled matrix rather than a gapped stack. Every row is a cell
with a hairline beneath it and a rule between label and value, so the
colophon reads in the same frame grammar as the panels above it.

Also: the floor lattice is carried past the content rail as a whisper, so
the hero drawing reads as larger than the frame that crops it — a detail the
reference has and we did not; the command palette's active row now carries
the same focus ring the activity grid draws on its active cell, so "where am
I" looks the same in both widgets; and row hover was raised in both themes,
where `--accent-muted` at 20% of accent in dark was barely legible.
